source_input: phone video dense frames -> COLMAP -> 2DGS -> mesh component
compute_time: COLMAP <10 min; 2DGS train about 5 min; eval about 2 min; mesh export/filter under 5 min
geometry_accuracy: Best camera-grounded geometry among A/B/C before mesh export; COLMAP registered 148/148 images with 24125 sparse points and 1.1296 px reprojection error. Geometry degrades when 2DGS is converted to mesh.
texture_detail: Best evidence of real texture/color because it is reconstructed from real images; 2DGS dense-half reached PSNR 24.7654, SSIM 0.8228, LPIPS 0.3000. Non-umbrella low-texture side remains blurry after mesh extraction.
fusion_readiness: Usable after component filtering and manual pose tuning, but not clean enough for direct perfect insertion.
main_distortion: Failure starts at TSDF/mesh extraction: table/background shell and connected-component ambiguity; low-texture side is smeared while high-contrast umbrella side survives better.
quantitative_evidence: component_02 selected with 19922 vertices and 38636 faces; mesh_res1024 post mesh had 12275319 vertices, 23782653 faces, 610.9 MB and was too contaminated for fusion.
final_use: Selected for fusion as Object A with explicit limitation.

source_input: text prompt -> threestudio DreamFusion/SDS -> textured OBJ
compute_time: 10000 steps; selected run train time 47:39 on cuda:1; other prompt variants about 49:41 and 50:03
geometry_accuracy: Moderate. The selected style-constrained prompt gives the cleanest silhouette and handle/body stability, but local shape still contains SDS roughness and generated-object orientation is arbitrary.
texture_detail: Moderate. 1024x1024 texture is usable but neutral/low-detail; less faithful than real multiview reconstruction because texture is hallucinated from text prior.
fusion_readiness: Good after selecting style-constrained prompt and rotating/scaling in Blender; fusion readiness score 4/5.
main_distortion: SDS hallucination and Janus/ghosting risk. Simple prompt had fuzzy/noisy surface; detailed prompt had haze and blur; selected prompt reduces but does not remove surface roughness.
quantitative_evidence: selected run: 39314 vertices, 78628 faces, 1024x1024 texture, geometry_score=4, texture_score=3, fusion_readiness_score=4, low Janus artifacts.
final_use: Selected for fusion as Object B.

source_input: single image -> background removal -> Magic123 -> textured OBJ
compute_time: fine training about 16.724 min for auto mask; raw/refined variants about 16.86 and 17.87 min
geometry_accuracy: Moderate-low. The front view and silhouette are recognizable, but side/back geometry is partially inferred and can be inflated or structurally distorted.
texture_detail: Moderate. 2048x2048 albedo preserves visible front details better with auto mask, but backside/side texture is hallucinated and edge noise remains.
fusion_readiness: Good only at smaller scale; selected auto-mask variant has fusion readiness score 4/5 but visible structural artifacts remain.
main_distortion: Single-image ambiguity and mask sensitivity. Raw input causes background texture contamination; refined mask reduces background but worsens inflated/distorted side geometry; auto mask is the best compromise.
quantitative_evidence: selected run: 25874 vertices, 50000 faces, 2048x2048 texture, geometry_score=4, texture_score=4, fusion_readiness_score=4.
final_use: Selected for fusion as Object C at reduced scale with limitation discussion.
